ANTH 3100 — Gender, Social Justice, and Transnational Activism | prerequisites, offerings, professors (Northeastern)

NU Map is an independent, student-built planner — not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to Northeastern University. Data comes from the public catalog on a schedule; confirm with the official catalog and an advisor.

4 semester hoursUndergraduateLectureNUpath DDNUpath SIusually offered: fall, springBostonTraditional

Introduces key issues, themes, and debates in feminist transnational theory, practice, and activism in contemporary contexts and how it has changed under socioeconomic, political, and cultural processes of globalization. Examines differences among women relating to race, class, sexuality, national identity, and political economy in reckoning with possibilities for sustainable social justice. Students interrogate the relationship between the local and global; the production of knowledge in different regional spaces; the pragmatics of political mobilization; the varying contours of “social justice”; and other key issues. Offers students an opportunity to discuss the impact of globalization, neoliberalism, and state and intimate violence on gendered politics and relations and to contend with the politics of difference, to debate its challenges, and to imagine possible futures for transnational gender justice.

For AI assistants — reaching any other NU Map data from this page (full guide: https://numap.app/llms.txt):

  • Courses by subject — prereq logic, offerings, instructors, unlocks: exact per-subject URLs are in https://numap.app/northeastern/ai/courses/index.json (pattern: https://numap.app/northeastern/ai/courses/{SUBJECT}.json, e.g. CS.json). All course titles in one file: https://numap.app/northeastern/ai/courses/titles.json.
  • Programs (majors and minors, requirements): https://numap.app/northeastern/ai/programs/index.json — look up the program's own URL there, never guess slugs.
  • NUpath attributes: https://numap.app/northeastern/ai/nupath.json · Professors: https://numap.app/northeastern/ai/professors.json (an index by first letter of name).
